opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__facts:
In the tender the complainant had deposited a total sum of Rs.7,84,500/- by way of earnest money and had sought allotment of shop Nos.47 and 62.
The process of tender was cancelled due to which Nagar Parishad Makdon had to refund all the deposited amount to the prospective tenderers.
On the allegation that applicant had purchased the stamp on which the affidavit was eventually executed which was submitted before the Nagar Parishad, Makdon, he has been implicated for the present offence.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__arguments:
There is no allegation against him that he purchased the stamp in his own name or executed any affidavit which was submitted to the Nagar Parishad, Makdon.
His role is limited only to the purchase of the stamp and nothing more.
There is no allegation against the applicant of in any manner being personally involved in misappropriation of the amount of the complainant or that he has received any amount.
opennyai_summary.20_February_2023__ANALYSIS:
There is no allegation against the applicant of himself swearing the affidavit or in any other manner executing the same.
There does not appear to any allegation against him of personally financially benefiting in the matter.
The case is based on documentary evidence which evidence is on record in view of which custodial interrogation of the applicant does not appear to be necessary.
The applicant has undertaken to cooperate in the investigation.
Thus in view of the available facts of the case, I deem it fit to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Prosecution story in brief is that the applicants/ accused persons entered into criminal conspiracy with intent to cheat the complainant Pradeep and in furtherance of the conspiracy the accused persons induced the complainant Pradeep to purchase a land for investment and told him that thereby he will gain a good profit.
The accused persons received a sum of Rs.94,00,000/- during period 01/03/2022-23/12/2023 in different installments from complainant through cash, R.T.G.S.
and online payment.
There was no signature of complainant Pradeep in the agreement.
During investigation, it was revealed that the aforesaid agreement was forged.
Later on the accused persons could not get the aforesaid land registered in complainant's name, then the complainant asked the accused persons to return his money.
opennyai_summary.14_August_2024__arguments:
On other hand learned counsel for the State as well as learned counsel for the Objector have opposed the prayer and submitted that the accused persons have made a forged agreement to sell dated 16/03/2022 while Shakir Hussain in his statement recorded u/S 161 of Cr.P.C. clearly stated that he did not execute the aforesaid agreement.
The accused persons have also used the aforesaid agreement and cheated the complainant and wrongfully gained a sum of Rs.94,00,000/-.
The offence is serious in nature.
The accused persons are an influenced persons so they can influence the witnesses, there is also possibility of them absconding.
Applicant Kaleem Khan has 2 criminal antecedents.
Therefore, the applicants are not entitled for bail.
opennyai_summary.14_August_2024__ANALYSIS: Also considering the increase in the number of these types of offences in all the developing regions, this court is of considered opinion that it is not a fit case to grant bail to the applicants.
